design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and vary only the registered prior-versus-case weighting state within each pair.
Downstream prompts are standalone information-value forecasts rather than posterior judgments about the probe hypothesis; use new domains and entities and include one response contract.
Keep the registered prior, evidence polarity, and moderate-strength metadata schedule explicit without naming the construct.

probe_train.instructions: Generate matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep all evidence facts and wording identical within a pair except the registered weighting clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered weighting clause inside Scenario and append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new hypotheses. Change only the registered weighting clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone forecasts of whether one follow-up check would change a new decision. Use assigned metadata, do not reproduce the probe hypothesis, and include exactly one response contract.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone forecast pool with the same registered metadata schedule. Do not reproduce a probe hypothesis or ask for a posterior; include exactly one response contract.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone information-change forecasts for calibration. Do not name prior weighting or diagnosticity; include exactly one response contract.
